summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; repository source and Accepted ADRs are fact authority; projections/indexes remain derived_cache; deterministic locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence only; callers must reread and hash-verify; trusted adapters constrain domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence; VDD records post-reread decisions, rejected or uncovered required modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses only VDD-frozen decisions; Bootstrap Review freezes context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback disabled unless approved, then only run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local main without fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation; no authorization for phase routes, Hosted E2, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, or commit; extends ADR-0044 and complements ADR-0037/0041/0043, none superseded
